arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا لَمْ أَزَلْ أَتَصَرَّفُ فِيهِ مِنْ سَلاَمَةِ بَدَنِي، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا أَحْدَثْتَ بِيْ مِنْ عِلَّة فِي جَسَـدِي.
transliteration: allāhumma lakal-ḥamdu ʿalā mā lam azal atasarrafu fīhi min salāmati badanī walaka al-ḥamd ʿalā mā aḥdath-ta bī min ʿillah fī jasadī
english_text: O God, to Thee belongs praise for the good health of my body which lets me move about, and to Thee belongs praise, for the ailments which Thou causest to arise in my flesh!

arabic_text: فَمَا أَدْرِي يَـا إلهِي، أَيُّ الْحَالَيْنِ أَحَقُّ بِالشُّكْرِ لَكَ، وَأَيُّ الْوَقْتَيْنِ أوْلَى بِالْحَمْدِ لَكَ، أَوَقْتُ الصِّحَةِ الَّتِي هَنَّـأْتَنِي فِيهَا طَيِّبَاتِ رِزْقِكَ، وَنَشَّطْتَنِي بِهَا لابْتِغاءِ مَرْضَاتِكَ وَفَضْلِكَ،
transliteration: famā ʾadrī yā ʾilāhī, ayyu al-ḥalayn aḥaqqu bilshukri lak wa ayyu alwaqatayni aula bi alhamdi laka awaktu al-ṣiḥḥat al-latī hannātinī fīhā ṭayyibāt rizqika wa-naššaṭtanī bihā labtiġā'i marḍātika wa faḍlika
english_text: For I know not, my God, which of the two states deserves more my thanking Thee and which of the two times is more worthy for my praise of Thee: the time of health, within which Thou makest me delight in the agreeable things of Thy provision, through which Thou givest me the joy to seek the means to Thy good pleasure and bounty,

arabic_text: وَقَوَّيْتَنِي مَعَهَا عَلَى مَـا وَفَّقْتَنِي لَهُ مِنْ طَـاعَتِـكَ
transliteration: waqawwaytanī maʿahā ʿalā mā waffaqtanī lahū min ṭāʿatika
english_text: and by which Thou strengthenest me for the acts of obedience which Thou hast given me success to accomplish;

arabic_text: أَمْ وَقْتُ الْعِلَّةِ الَّتِي مَحَّصْتَنِي بِهَا، وَالنِّعَمِ الَّتِي أَتْحَفْتَنِي بِهَا تَخْفِيفاً لِمَا ثَقُلَ بِهِ عَلَى ظَهري مِنَ الْخَطِيئاتِ وَتَطْهيراً لِمَا انْغَمَسْتُ فيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ ،
transliteration: am waqtu al-ʿillati al-latī maḥḥaṣtanī bihā wa al-niʿami allati athraftani biha takhfīfan limā thaqula bihī ʿalā ẓahri minal-khaṭīʾāt wa-taṭhīrān limā inghamastu fīhi mina al-sayyi’āt
english_text: or the time of illness through which Thou puttest me to the test and bestowest upon me favours: lightening of the offenses that weigh down my back, purification of the evil deeds into which I have plunged,

arabic_text: وَتَنْبِيهاً لِتَنَاوُلِ التَّوْبَةِ، وَتَذْكِيراً لِمَحْوِ الْحَوْبَةِ بِقَدِيمِ النِّعْمَةِ،
transliteration: wa tanbīhan li-tanāwuli al-tawbah, wa taẓkirān li-maḥwi al-ḥawbah bi-qadīmi al-niʿmah
english_text: incitement to reach for repentance, reminder of the erasure of misdeeds through ancient favour;

arabic_text: وَفِي خِلاَلِ ذَلِكَ مَا كَتَبَ لِيَ الْكَاتِبَانِ مِنْ زَكِيِّ الأعْمَالِ، مَا لا قَلْبٌ فَكَّرَ فِيهِ، وَلا لِسَانٌ نَطَقَ بِهِ وَلاَ جَارِحَةٌ تَكَلَّفَتْهُ بَلْ إفْضَالاً مِنْكَ عَلَيَّ، وَإحْسَاناً مِنْ صَنِيعِـكَ إلَيَّ.
transliteration: wa fī khalāli dhālika mā kataba liya al-kātibān min zakīy al-aʿmāl, mā lā qalbun fakkara fīh wala lisānun naṭaqabihi walā jāriḥatun takallafathu bal ifḍālan minka ʿalayya wa-iḥsānan min ṣanīʿika ilayya
english_text: and, through all that, what the two writers write for me: blameless acts, which no heart had thought, no tongue had uttered, and no limb had undertaken, rather, as Thy bestowal of bounty upon me and the beneficence of Thy benefaction toward me.

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّـد وَآلِـهِ وَحَبِّبْ إلَيّ مَـا رَضِيتَ لِي ، وَيَسِّرْ لِي مَا أَحْلَلْتَ بِيْ، وَطَهِّرْنِي مِنْ دَنَسِ مَا أَسْلَفْتُ ،
transliteration: allāhumma faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi waḥabbib ilayya mā raḍīta lī wayassir li mā ahlalt biy wa ṭahhirnī min danasi mā aslaftu
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, make me love what Thou hast approved for me, make easy for me what Thou hast sent down upon me, purify me of the defilement of what I have sent ahead,

arabic_text: وَامْحُ عَنِّي شَرَّ مَا قَـدَّمْتُ، وَأَوْجِدْنِي حَلاَوَةَ الْعَافِيَةِ ، وَأَذِقْنِي بَرْدَ السَّلاَمَةِ وَاجْعَلْ مَخْرَجِي عَنْ عِلَّتِي إلَى عَفْوِكَ، وَمُتَحَوَّلِي عَنْ صَرْعَتِي إلَى تَجَاوُزِكَ،
transliteration: wa-amhu 'anni sharra ma qaddamtu wa-awjednī ḥalāwata al-ʿāfiyah, wa-ʾaḏiqnī barda as-salāmah waj'al makhrajī ʿan ʿil-latī ilā ʿafwik wa mutaḥawwali ʿan ṣarʿatī ilā tajāwuzika
english_text: erase the evil of what I have done beforehand, let me find the sweetness of well-being, let me taste the coolness of safety, and appoint for me a way out from my illness to Thy pardon, transformation of my infirmity into Thy forbearance,

arabic_text: وَخَلاصِي مِنْ كَرْبِي إلَى رَوْحِكَ، وَسَلاَمَتِي مِنْ هَذِهِ الشِّدَّةِ إلَى فَرَجِكَ،
transliteration: wa khalaṣī min karbī ilā rūhika wa-salāmatī min hādhīhi ash-shiddah ilá farajik
english_text: escape from my distress to Thy refreshment, and safety from this hardship in Thy relief!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ الْمُتَفَضِّلُ بِالإِحْسَانِ، الْمُتَطَوِّلُ بِالامْتِنَانِ، الْوَهَّابُ الْكَرِيمُ، ذُو الْجَلاَلِ وَالإكْرَامِ
transliteration: 'innaka almutafadhdhilu bil'ihsani al-mutaṭawwilu bil-imtināni, al-wahhābu al-karīmu dhū al-jalāli wal-ikrām
english_text: Thou art gratuitously bountiful in beneficence, ever gracious in kindness, the Generous, the Giver, Possessor of majesty and munificence!
